cases.refreshed: Middle and high schoolers: Come explore the TeenHQ MakerSpace! Up to 5 teens at a time can use our 3D printers, a poster printer, a Glowforge laser cutter, sewing machines and sergers, a Cricut, a button press, and assorted craft supplies. Work with our teen librarian to bring your idea to life. Equipment and materials have limits and time requirements. All services are provided for free to middle and high school students (grades 6-12). Younger people and adults are not permitted in the area unless required to assist with a disability. In-person sign-up starts at 3:45 p.m. on the day of the event. The first five teens are guaranteed a spot. The area is wheelchair accessible from the Children's Room elevator. Other accommodations can be made available upon request. Allow enough time to set up the equipment and work on your project. If your work takes longer than one studio session, you may need to come back to pick up a finished item or continue the project at another session. We appreciate your patience and flexibility. 3D Printing: All requested prints must take less than 4.5 hours to print. All requested prints will need to be picked up at a later date. Contact information is required for notification of pick-up. 3D print quality and the time needed to complete prints are not guaranteed. Multiple objects can be printed as long as the total time does not exceed 4.5 hours. Poster Printing: Set up your design on a 24 × 36-inch canvas and save it as a PNG file. Please see the regularly scheduled poster printing event for further details. One poster per teen per day. Glowforge: Create a custom engraved object. Follow guidelines similar to those for the Custom Keychain Program. The librarian decides how complex a request can be. Sewing & Serger Machines: It is recommended that you bring your own fabric and thread if fabric is special or color is a factor. Scrap material and thread are available, but we cannot guarantee material quality or availability. An iron and ironing board are also available. Cricut: Basic Cricut supplies are available, such as construction and cardstock paper. If your project is specialized, such as requiring iron-on, you'll need to bring your own materials. It is recommended that you know the requirements for any materials you provide. Button Press: TeenHQ offers two sizes of button presses. We cannot offer printing. If you bring your own printout of buttons, it must be printed on standard printer paper. Paper thicker than standard printer paper cannot be used on the button presses. All measurements below are diameters in inches. Small Button Press: 1.25"; Large Button Press: 2.25"; Picture Size: 1.156"; Cut Line: 1.629"; Picture Size: 2.063"; Cut Line: 2.625".
